An incomplete cast copper alloy penannular brooch of Roman date. The brooch is Fowler's (1960) Type E (after Booth (2014)) with a flattened, decorated hoop and rolled back terminals that are decoratively notched with transverse grooves and recessed 'eye' holes and nostrils which together resemble an animal's head in abstract.
